ai_summary: GMM Pfaudler reported stable Q1 FY26 revenue, achieving strong profitability growth driven primarily by its India business, which saw a 45% YoY EBITDA increase and improved consolidated margins to 12.7%. Robust order intake of INR 1,004 crores and a healthy backlog provide good future visibility, further bolstered by the strategic SEMCO acquisition expanding their global mixing platform. However, the company faces headwinds from global uncertainties, a slowdown in the international glass-lined business, and material accounting impacts including a INR 20 crores unrealized forex loss and an unusually high 68% effective tax rate.
